name: Anny AI
description:
Anny helps hotel commercial teams see what is changing in their market. Connect Claude to your Anny workspace to compare competitor rates, review estimated demand, track how rates move over time, and find local events that overlap upcoming stays, all in plain language.

Read across your organizations, hotels, and Comp Sets, the competitor groups you shop against. Pull a rate matrix, or a summary giving current rates, estimated demand, freshness confidence, and movement for every competitor and arrival date. Look back over rate and demand history, recent rate reports, shop runs and their results, and current shopping schedules. For Event Intelligence, list the events affecting a hotel and open the observations and sources behind any one of them. You can also search the Anny Help Center for product guidance, or send a suggestion to the Anny team.

With your approval, Claude can make changes: rename a hotel or update its code, edit the competitors and parity channels in a Comp Set, adjust default and weekday shopping schedules, configure Event Intelligence, flag an event for correction, and publish or suppress an event.

Two actions are billable, starting an on-demand rate shop and refreshing Event Intelligence. Claude asks you to confirm before either one, and you can check the relevant Shop Pool first to see what is available to spend.

Start with: "What changed in my market over the next seven days?"

_published_faq.name: How do I add Anny AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Anny AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.anny.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Anny AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anny AI lists 28 MCP tools, including comp_set_editor_get, comp_set_get, comp_set_update_members, event_configure, event_correction_request, event_history_get, event_publication_set, event_refresh, event_run_evidence_get, event_state_get, events_list, and hotel_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Anny AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Anny AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Anny AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anny AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Anny AI is developed by Anny AI, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
